pages.title: The work
pages.text:
**Assignment list:** chapter **Strand: Clock**. A peer path — not a gate you must finish first.

Create. Water wheels, presses, mixers, belts — one cog, then the same cog again. The precision mechanism wants a Binding Knot at its heart.

Finish the **Clock Knot** and seat Clock. One of the two seats Bind needs.

pages.title: Pattern
pages.text: The Pattern-weavers sang factories the way you would sing a round. A factory is a song that has stopped needing the singer.
